ios.desc:
DrakeAI makes expense tracking effortless. Just type what you spent in plain language and the AI parses everything - amount, category, date, and merchant - in seconds.

No more spreadsheets. No more filling out forms. Just talk to DrakeAI like a human.

CHAT-BASED LOGGING
Type "coffee at Starbucks 5.50" or "groceries $120 yesterday" and DrakeAI extracts every field automatically. Inline expense cards appear right in the chat so you can verify and edit on the spot.

RECEIPT SCANNING
Point your camera at any receipt. DrakeAI reads the text via OCR, sends it through the AI, and creates a categorized expense entry - with the original image attached for your records.

SPENDING ANALYTICS
See where your money goes. Browse spending by category, day, or month. Switch between your personal expenses, all family spending, or a specific group - right from the Analytics screen.

SMART INSIGHTS
Ask questions in plain language:
- "How much did I spend this month?"
- "What's my top category?"
- "What was my biggest expense?"
- "What's my average expense?"

The Insights tab answers instantly from your actual data.

FAMILY & GROUP EXPENSES
Create shared expense groups for your household or any group of people. Add members, assign expenses to the group, and filter your analytics and expense list by personal, family, or any specific group. Manage groups from your profile.

QUICK EDITS
Made a mistake? Tap any expense to edit the amount, category, or date in a fast bottom-sheet - no navigation, no wasted time.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Sign in with Google, Apple, or continue as a guest. Your data syncs to your account across sessions.

DrakeAI is built for people who want to know where their money goes without spending time on data entry. Log an expense in the same time it takes to pay for it.
